title: observation/1
description: What a probe saw for one rule in one context of one product version. Give `facts` (the engine evaluates the rule) or `outcome` (counted only for the same rule version), or both.

version.description: a commit sha, an image digest, a clone sha or a capture date

context.description: viewport, role, locale, device class; compared only within one context

facts.description: the facts the check of the rule is evaluated over

evidence.description: refs: structure-fact files, hashes, counts; never screenshots of third-party products

stamp.description: sha-256 of a gatetrain-style stamp file proving the run

run.description: the repeat this observation belongs to (repeats give the noise band)
